portedFromTheOracle.quantity: src/renderer.js drawPostDive(): for each of the 16 compartments, ab = combinedAB(i) (src/physics.js: a and b weighted by the nitrogen and helium loads, ZHL-16C nitrogen values for a compartment under 0.0001 bar), m0 = ab.a + 1.0 / ab.b, loading = (tissues[i] + tissuesHe[i]) / m0: the load as a share of the M-value at the surface, with no gradient factor. In the migration this is compartmentSaturation(tissues, 1).mValueRatio (src/planner/dive-planner.ts), the function the gas-information page's tissue bars use at the current depth; the post-dive summary takes it at 1.0 bar, legacy's surface.
portedFromTheOracle.bars: Height min(barMaxH, loading * barMaxH), so full at the M-value and no taller; nitrogen n2Frac = tissues[i] / total (1 below 0.0001 bar) of it at the bottom, helium the rest on top, drawn only when over 0.5 px of the 100 px bar; nitrogen hudColor('danger') above 0.9, 'caution' above 0.7, else 'ok', helium #34e6ff; an M-value line at the top of each bar; the compartment number under each; a legend for N2 and He; STRINGS.*.tissueLoading as the heading.
portedFromTheOracle.text: postDive.tissues (en, de) is legacy's STRINGS.*.tissueLoading verbatim; postDive.tissues.alt names the bars for assistive technology; postDive.tissues.key.* is the legend. STRINGS.*.tissueLoading and postDive.tissues* are anchored under DECOMPRESSION-001.

departuresInPresentation: The bars are HTML boxes in a 16-column grid sized in percent, so they take the screen's width as the profile chart does (legacy draws both 320 px wide). The bars follow the violations list rather than sitting straight under the chart, so the chart's numbered markers stay next to the entries they number; legacy has no such list. To assistive technology the bars are one role=img named by a sentence: the measure, and the compartment with the highest loading and its percentage. The legend also names the M-value line, which legacy's legend leaves unexplained, and is aria-hidden as the sentence and the heading carry the meaning. The tier colours are the screen's score-tier colours.

parity: tests/parity/post-dive.test.ts runs legacy's own source: the ZHL16C_N2 and ZHL16C_HE tables from src/constants.js, combinedAB() from src/physics.js and drawPostDive()'s statements from `var ab = combinedAB(i);` to the nitrogen fill from src/renderer.js, extracted with ?raw, against every checkpoint of every recorded trace in tests/fixtures/traces/baseline-v1.json (65), comparing loading, the nitrogen and helium heights (toBeCloseTo) and the tier with the summary's bars. The coverage test requires air-18m-30min/surfaced, the trace that ends on legacy's post-dive screen, and that the fixture exercises a helium part and all three tiers.
